summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure access to broadband for schools and students.

claims.argument: Reducing or eliminating E-Rate would force districts to cut staff and prioritize other costs over essential infrastructure
claims.evidence_quote: Germantown Hills Sch Dist 69 has received $97,626 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $19,525 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running. E-Rate’s success over the past three decades should be viewed as a reason to preserve and improve the program — not as a reason to assume that the work is finished.
